hint.text:
Commas are used to separate two main clauses. There should be a comma placed before the coordinating conjunction that joins two main clauses together.

Commas are also used to separate subordinate clauses from main clauses. There should be a comma placed after the subordinate clause, but only if it comes at the beginning of the sentence.

instruction.text: Use the coordinating conjunction to join the two sentences together.

atoms.a:
but

I used to have a job in a café. The café shut down.
atoms.sound: I used to have a job in a café. The café shut down.

atoms.a:
and

Zari found a cake recipe online. Addison went to buy the ingredients for the cake.
atoms.sound: Zari found a cake recipe online. Addison went to buy the ingredients for the cake.

atoms.a:
or

You can wear the purple socks. You can wear the blue socks.
atoms.sound: You can wear the purple socks. You can wear the blue socks.

instruction.text: The following sentence is missing a comma. First, select the subordinate clause.

atoms.sound: If you burn the food the smoke alarm will ring.

instruction.text: Now, add a comma after the subordinate clause to correctly punctuate the text.

atoms.b: If you burn the food((,)) the smoke alarm will ring.

instruction.text: The following sentence is missing a comma. First, select the subordinate clause.

atoms.sound: Although Martha doesn’t like physics she did well in the test.

instruction.text: Now, add a comma after the subordinate clause to correctly punctuate the text.

atoms.b: Although Martha doesn’t like physics((,)) she did well in the test.

instruction.text: The following sentence is missing a comma. First, select the subordinate clause.

atoms.sound: After he has finished work Beau is going to pick up his daughter from school.

instruction.text: Now, add a comma after the subordinate clause to correctly punctuate the text.

atoms.b: After he has finished work((,)) Beau is going to pick up his daughter from school.

instruction.text: Is a comma necessary in the following sentence?

atoms.a: Alex doesn’t eat mushrooms because she doesn’t like them.
Although Huw doesn’t enjoy maths he is very good at it.
If you forget your homework you will have to stay for detention after school.
